resources.string: Eliminate those who stand in your path.
Kill players by using your dope abilities!\%nl\%Preferably, explode \%b\%only\%/b\% in a secluded area.
The Sentinel is a Neutral Killing role that can explode themselves to kill anyone nearby. They may also kill normally, but where's the fun in that?
Open the map and step through it.
Open the map and click anywhere on it to \%b\%teleport\%/b\% there.
The Apparater is a Crewmate Power role that can open the map and click a location to instantly teleport there.
Open the map. Click anywhere on it to teleport to that location.
You turn \%b\%invisible\%/b\% whenever nobody can see you.
The Invisible Boy is a Crewmate Support role that turns invisible whenever no living player has line of sight to him. The moment anyone can see even a sliver of him, he is visible again.
While no living player can see you, you are invisible - hidden from players, cameras, and the admin table. You see yourself as a ghostly outline. Dead players don't count; players in vents do.
Enter the spirit realm and kill before your tether to reality breaks.
Phase into an \%b\%invisible spirit\%/b\% that walks through walls.\%nl\%When your tether breaks, you snap back to where you phased from.

The Astral is an Impostor Concealing role that can phase into a spirit form: invisible, able to walk through walls, and still able to kill. When the form ends they are pulled back to the spot they phased from, staying invisible for a few seconds longer to slip away.
Become an invisible spirit that walks through walls and can still kill. When the form ends, you return to where you phased from and remain invisible briefly.
